title: Cattan, Rodrigues & Congedo 2019 — Passive Head-Mounted Display Music-Listening EEG dataset (PHMD)
description: This dataset comprises electroencephalographic recordings from 12 healthy subjects during music listening with and without a passive head-mounted display (PHMD). The study employed a 16-channel EEG headset to investigate the effects of smartphone-based head-mounted displays on neural activity during auditory stimulation. Data were collected in a resting-state paradigm with alternating blocks of smartphone switched-on and switched-off conditions, providing a resource for brain-computer interface research and virtual reality applications.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a 16-channel g.USBamp system (sampling rate: 512 Hz) with wet electrodes in a standard 10-20 montage. Subjects sat approximately 50 cm from a screen while wearing an EEG cap and Samsung Gear head-mounted display. The protocol consisted of 10 blocks (60 seconds each) with alternating smartphone on/off conditions in randomized order. Recordings were performed with eyes open, no digital filtering applied, and no Faraday cage to simulate real-world conditions.
